description: Structured eval definitions for the ACM Private CA Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across ACM PCA provisioning (root CA with CRL and S3 bucket policy, subordinate CA signed by parent with ACM integration, end-entity certificate issuance with correct template, CA deletion with 30-day waiting period, missing CRL S3 bucket policy prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Root CA with CRL revocation and S3 bucket policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — root CA, RSA_2048, SHA256withRSA, CRL with S3 bucket + policy, self-signed RootCACertificate/V1, ACTIVE status
eval_cases.prompt: Create a private root CA in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Key algorithm RSA_2048, signing algorithm SHA256withRSA. Subject: CN=Example Root CA, O=Example Org, C=US. Enable CRL revocation with S3 bucket acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1, expiration 7 days, CNAME crl.example.com. Self-signed root certificate valid 10 years using RootCACertificate/V1 template. Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=trust-anchor.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_PCA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/aaaa-bbbb-cccc (ROOT, RSA_2048, SHA256withRSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] CA type: ROOT
  [✓] Key algorithm: RSA_2048
  [✓] Signing algorithm: SHA256withRSA
  [✓] Subject DN: CN=Example Root CA, O=Example Org, C=US
  [✓] Revocation: CRL (bucket acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1, expiration 7 days)
  [✓] CRL S3 bucket: acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1 — exists
  [✓] CRL bucket policy: grants acm-pca.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject
  [✓] CA status: ACTIVE
  [✓] CA certificate: self-signed (RootCACertificate/V1, validity 10 years)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm-pca describe-certificate-authority --certificate-authority-arn <ca-arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Subordinate CA signed by active root CA with ACM integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — subordinate CA, parent CA ACTIVE + create-permission, parent-signed cert, ACM service principal permission for managed lifecycle
eval_cases.prompt: Create a subordinate CA in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Parent root CA ARN: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/aaaa-bbbb-cccc. The parent CA is ACTIVE and has create-permission granted. Key algorithm RSA_2048, signing algorithm SHA256withRSA. Subject: CN=Example Subordinate CA, O=Example Org, C=US. Enable CRL with bucket acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1, expiration 7 days. Also enable OCSP. Subordinate certificate valid 5 years using SubordinateCACertificate_PathLen0/V1 template. Grant ACM service principal permission for managed cert lifecycle. Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=issuing-ca.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_PCA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/dddd-eeee-ffff (SUBORDINATE, RSA_2048, SHA256withRSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] CA type: SUBORDINATE
  [✓] Key algorithm: RSA_2048
  [✓] Signing algorithm: SHA256withRSA
  [✓] Subject DN: CN=Example Subordinate CA, O=Example Org, C=US
  [✓] Revocation: CRL + OCSP
  [✓] CA status: ACTIVE
  [✓] CA certificate: parent-signed (parent arn:...:aaaa-bbbb-cccc)
  [✓] Parent CA permission: create-permission granted
  [✓] ACM integration: create-permission for acm.amazonaws.com

eval_cases.name: End-entity TLS certificate from subordinate CA
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — end-entity cert from ACTIVE subordinate CA, EndEntityCertificate_CertPassedPathLen_0 template, 365-day validity
eval_cases.prompt: Issue an end-entity certificate from subordinate CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/dddd-eeee-ffff in us-east-1. The subordinate CA is ACTIVE. CSR is ready at server.csr. Signing algorithm SHA256withRSA. Use template EndEntityCertificate/CertPassedPathLen/0. Validity 365 days. Tags: Environment=production, Service=api.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_PCA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/dddd-eeee-ffff (SUBORDINATE, RSA_2048, SHA256withRSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Certificate template: EndEntityCertificate/CertPassedPathLen/0
  [✓] CA status: ACTIVE
  [✓] Signing algorithm: SHA256withRSA
  [✓] Validity: 365 days

eval_cases.name: CA deletion with mandatory 30-day waiting period
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CA deletion with 30-day waiting period, restore capability documented, permanent deletion after expiry
eval_cases.prompt: Delete the subordinate CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/dddd-eeee-ffff in us-east-1 with a 30-day permanent deletion waiting period. Existing certificates should remain valid during this period. Document the restore capability.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_PCA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/dddd-eeee-ffff (SUBORDINATE)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] CA deletion initiated with 30-day waiting period
  [✓] Restore capability: restore-certificate-authority available during waiting period
  [✓] Existing certificates remain valid
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm-pca describe-certificate-authority --certificate-authority-arn <ca-arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: CRL configured but S3 bucket policy missing (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — S3 bucket exists but no policy granting acm-pca.amazonaws.com write access; CRL publication would silently fail
eval_cases.prompt: Create a private root CA in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Key algorithm RSA_2048, signing algorithm SHA256withRSA. Subject: CN=Example Root CA, O=Example Org, C=US. Enable CRL revocation with S3 bucket acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1. The S3 bucket exists but does NOT have a bucket policy granting acm-pca.amazonaws.com write access.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_PCA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/aaaa-bbbb-cccc (ROOT, RSA_2048, SHA256withRSA)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] CRL bucket policy: FAIL — bucket acm-pca-crl-123456789012-us-east-1 does not grant acm-pca.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject; CRL publication would silently fail
